subject: Happy Christmas 2009
author: ZombieTron
body:
We just got back from our family Christmas, as we celebrate on Christmas Eve in Norway, we had a really lovely dinner and baby girl got lots of lovely presents!

I am going to be cooking turkey tomorrow, and we have more pressies to open too! So, we are getting 2 Christmas's this year!!

I hope you all have a wonderful day tomorrow, and a very fabulous new year! 😃 🎁 🎮 ❤️ 🍸 👏 🌙 🥵

body: Id like to wish you all a very merry christmas and a happy new year .... i hope you all get what you want of santa 😉 i know your going to have a great christmas zombs with the baby ....... the first christmas is always the best 😃 ....... and yes ill be hosting a great room on revenge on christmas eve please feel free to join any of you ...... ❤️
